Create ONE finished high-quality transparent 2D EVO game fish asset by organically COMBINING the TWO supplied FIRST-TIER reference fish. Both reference features are STAGE 1 and must stay exactly at this early evolutionary strength. There is NO stage-3 dominant feature in this task. Make both stage-1 traits visibly present in one beautifully coherent full-body character; preserve their distinctive existing shapes rather than merely hinting at them. Do not invent a new species or promote either feature to stage 2 or 3.

Exact shared character/style anchor: stout slate-blue silver starting fish, same rounded body and silver belly, large round cream-and-black eye with the same white highlight, dark simple integrated gill fold, ivory grey slightly translucent fin membranes, very dark navy organic outer ink contour, quiet broad softly brushed painted lighting masses, restrained handmade texture. Match the two reference images closely. This must sit beside the existing EVO drawings as the very same animal. A few deliberate anatomical lines, no busy decoration. Keep body and head proportions, eye size and position, natural fish anatomy and top-left lighting. Any skull plates must be broad sculpted ivory-grey prehistoric bone and any teeth natural ivory.

Orthographic STRICT SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT, horizontal neutral relaxed swimming pose, not attacking. Full fish with head at RIGHT, tail at LEFT; no additional angles, no detached parts, no extra fish. Keep every fin tip and the whole snout inside the canvas with clear empty margins. Native landscape PNG ideally 1675 x 939. True transparent alpha background; no water, bubbles, backdrop, halo, outside shadow, text, numbers, frames or watermark. Clean readable shapes at 90 pixels, exceptional polished painterly game asset finish.
